title: STN-TGAT Graph Attention Network for H198 Cross-Sectional Stock Ranking
description: Port the Soft-Threshold NMI-prior Transformer Graph Attention Network (STN-TGAT) from arXiv:2607.19385 to the H198 30-stock NASDAQ large-cap universe. STN-TGAT jointly models temporal dynamics (Transformer) and cross-sectional stock dependencies (GAT) using an NMI-based prior graph with soft-threshold sparsification to filter noisy correlations. The key innovation over plain PRISM-VQ (H457) is explicit inter-stock relational modeling — high-momentum NASDAQ stocks are correlated in ways that carry predictive signal. The paper validates on Top-5 selection within the Top-50 S&P 500 constituents with explicit transaction cost adjustment, which directly maps to H198's top-6-from-30 structure. Variants: A (full STN-TGAT: Transformer temporal + GAT cross-sectional + NMI prior + soft-threshold), B (Transformer only, no GAT — ablation), C (GAT only, no Transformer — ablation), D (NMI prior only, uniform attention — ablation), E (H198 IMOM6+MOM60+LowVol+IMOM12 equal-weight baseline = H398 champion). Gate: OOS Sharpe > 4.068 (H398 champion) as stretch; > 1.174 as minimal gate. IS: 2013-2020, OOS: 2021-2026. Primary challenge: STN-TGAT requires deep learning infrastructure (PyTorch GNN) and careful look-ahead discipline in the NMI-based prior graph construction (must use lagged correlations only). Consider lightweight proxy: static sector-correlation adjacency matrix from GICS classification as prior graph, avoiding learning on future data.

# H464 — STN-TGAT Graph Attention Network for H198 Cross-Sectional Stock Ranking

## Source
arXiv:2607.19385 (Guo, Lu & Zhang, Jul 2026) 'STN-TGAT: Top-K Portfolio Construction via Prior-Guided Graph Attention with Learnable Soft-Threshold Sparsification'

## Key Paper Findings
- Jointly models temporal dynamics (Transformer) + cross-sectional dependencies (GAT)
- NMI-based prior graph with soft-threshold sparsification reduces noisy stock correlations
- Top-5 selection within Top-50 S&P 500 constituents; includes transaction cost adjustment
- Outperforms benchmark models in both predictive accuracy and portfolio returns
- Adaptive relational modeling + decision-aligned training = practically effective framework

## H198 Adaptation
- Universe: H198 30-stock NASDAQ large-cap (same universe as H395-H399 confirmed family)
- Prior graph: rolling 60-day NMI between stock returns (lagged to avoid look-ahead)
- Soft-threshold sparsification: keep edges with NMI > IS-calibrated 70th percentile
- Temporal encoder: 20-day lookback Transformer on daily returns + volume
- Portfolio: top-6 equal-weight selection (matching H198 structure)

## Variants
- A: Full STN-TGAT (Transformer + GAT + NMI + soft-threshold)
- B: Transformer-only ablation (no graph structure)
- C: GAT-only ablation (no Transformer temporal)
- D: NMI prior only, uniform attention (no learned threshold)
- E: H398 champion baseline (IMOM6+MOM60+LowVol+IMOM12 equal-weight)

## Gate
- Minimal: OOS Sharpe > 1.174 (H198 baseline)
- Stretch: OOS Sharpe > 4.068 (H398 champion)
- MaxDD improvement vs baseline

## IS/OOS Split
- IS: 2013-2020
- OOS: 2021-2026

## Script
backtesting/daily/run_h464_stn_tgat_h198.py

## CAUTION
- GNN training requires PyTorch Geometric or similar; venv setup needed
- NMI prior graph must use strictly lagged data only (t-1 correlations for t predictions)
- With only 30 stocks, K=8 neighbor graphs may be ill-conditioned; use K=5 or K=full
- Consider lightweight proxy first: static GICS sector adjacency as prior graph (no learning needed)
